metadata.description: IT lead who approves password resets, role changes, sign-outs, disabling and offboarding.

ActionName.title: ActionName
ActionName.description:
Which admin action to run. Use exactly one of these names (33).
User onboarding: OnboardUser (new joiner, preview first), CreateUser, CloneAccess, AssignLicence, SendEmail.
User management: GetUser, SearchUsers, UpdateUser, SetManager, RemoveManager, GetUserLicences, RemoveLicence, EnableUser, ResetPassword*, RevokeSessions*, DisableUser*, OffboardUser*.
Group management: ListGroups, ListGroupMembers, GetGroupMemberships, AddToGroups, RemoveFromGroups.
Entra ID administration: ListAssignableRoles, GetUserRoles, AssignRole*, RemoveRole*, GetSignInMethods, GetSignInStatus.
Questions and reports: GetManagerChain, GetDirectReports, CountByDepartment, AuditQuery, BuildExcelReport.
* = needs the IT lead's approval. The flow sends the approval and replies at once; nothing changes until the IT lead approves.

ParametersJson.title: ParametersJson
ParametersJson.description:
The parameters as one JSON object. Use people and groups by the name the user gave (for example "Ankit Verma", "Demo-VPN-Users"); the plugin finds them.
OnboardUser: displayName (starts with Demo-), givenName, surname, department, jobTitle, managerId, cloneFromUserId or groups, previewOnly (true for the summary, false only after the user confirms). Example: {"displayName":"Demo-Priya Sharma","givenName":"Priya","surname":"Sharma","department":"Finance","jobTitle":"Financial Analyst","managerId":"Rahul Mehta","cloneFromUserId":"Ankit Verma","previewOnly":true}
CloneAccess: sourceUserId, targetUserId, previewOnly. AddToGroups, RemoveFromGroups: userId, groups. Example: {"userId":"Neha Kapoor","groups":["Demo-VPN-Users"]}
UpdateUser: userId plus the fields to change (jobTitle, department, officeLocation, mobilePhone). SetManager: userId, managerId.
AssignLicence, RemoveLicence: userId, skus. AssignRole, RemoveRole: userId, role (for example "Reports Reader"). DisableUser: userId, revokeSessions.
SearchUsers: name, department and/or jobTitle. CountByDepartment: department (optional). ListGroups: nameStartsWith (optional). ListGroupMembers: group.
AuditQuery: userId, or source "log"; days. BuildExcelReport: reportType "Users" or "GroupMembers", department or group. ListAssignableRoles: {}.
Every other action: {"userId":"<name>"}. Never put a password in here.

RequestedBy.title: RequestedBy
RequestedBy.description: Optional. Name of the person asking, if known. Leave empty otherwise: the flow records the signed-in user.

ApprovalId.title: ApprovalId
ApprovalId.description: Optional. Leave empty. Risky actions get their approval ID from the IT lead's approval inside this flow; a value given here never skips an approval.
